skills.name: Shock Wave
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when performing a Full Charge attack. Affects the enemy unit nearest to the crosshair. Deals 40.45% of final ATK as sustained damage every second. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 5 sec. ■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects self. ATK ▲ 28.08% of the skill user's ATK for 10 sec.

skills.name: Blue Blade
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. Vital Attack: Damage to Parts ▲ 12.48% for 5 sec. ■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects self. Vital Attack: Damage to Parts ▲ 12.48% for 5 sec. ■ Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part. Affects self if self is not in A.N. Mode status. Single Point Attack: Sustained damage ▲ 27.96% for 15 sec. Removes Vital Attack.

skills.name: Tempest
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects all enemies (including parts). Deals 290.9% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage. ■ Affects self. A.N. Mode Effect 1: Removes Single Point Attack. Effect 2: Sustained damage ▲ 52.85% for 10 sec.
